system.description:
A Volatile creature is covered in extremely explosive carbon dust for the next minute.

If a Volatile creature takes fire or lightning damage, the carbon dust sparks and then explodes. When it does, all creatures within 5-feet of the exploding creature take 1d12 fire damage for every rank of Volatile that was detonated, then removing all ranks of Volatile.

A creature can only take damage from one Instance of a Volatile explosion.

A Creature that takes cold damage as a result of a jutsu with the Water Release keyword, submerges themselves in a body of water, or spend 1 action on their turns can cleanse itself of the Volatile condition.
system.summary: Fire or lightning damage detonates it: creatures within 5 ft take 1d12 fire per rank; 1 minute; an Action (or water) cleanses it.

removal.text: Spend 1 Action on its turn to cleanse it (or submerge in water, or take cold damage from a Water Release jutsu).

rules.text: When it takes fire or lightning damage, every creature within 5 ft takes 1d12 fire damage per rank, then it loses all ranks. A creature takes damage from only one Volatile explosion per instance.
